channel.title: Surflist blog
channel.description: Guides for planning a surf trip — schools, destinations, and how Surflist lists businesses.

item.title: How to choose a surf school
item.description: What to check before you book a surf lesson: group size, instructor qualifications, the beach, kit and whether the school is a real, operating business.

item.title: How to plan a surf trip with Surflist
item.description: Plan a surf trip by destination, not by brand. Use Surflist's country, region and town pages to find schools, shops, stays and board repair in one place.

item.title: What Surflist lists — and what it doesn't
item.description: How Surflist decides what appears: real businesses confirmed on their own website, organised by country, region and town. Verified is paid, not a quality score.

item.title: Beginner-friendly surf destinations on Surflist
item.description: Towns on Surflist where you can find beginner surf schools — sandy beach-break hubs in England, Morocco, Costa Rica, Indonesia and Mexico, with links to each town.
